newsitem.title: INDONESIA: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - June 24.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - June 24.

text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Indonesian press on June 24. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

The chairman of the Moslem-based United Development Party (PPP), Ismail Hasan Metareum, said he apologised to the people who voted for the party for endorsing the election results, despite the allegations of widespread electoral irregularities. Metareum said the endorsement, which was made reluctantly, was done for the sake of the country's unity.

The results of the May 29 general elections were announced on Monday with the ruling Golkar party winning 325 of the 425 seats in the House of Representatives. The Moslem-based United Development Party (PPP) won 89 seats and the Indonesian Democratic Party (PDI) won 11 seats.
Bank Indonesia Governor Sudradjad Djiwandono has said a healthy banking industry is the key to the achievement of sustainable economic growth.
The government has cancelled the controversial plan to hold a seminar to reassess the role of the country's first president Sukarno in a 1965 failed coup.
